headline: Rodez v Montpellier: Montpellier favoured, margin view unmoved
summary: Montpellier are the market favourite at 39.5% fair to win, against Rodez at 33.2% and the draw at 27.3%. The sharp market cut the draw from 30.8% to 27.3%, but the consensus draw moved only 1.0 point, from 28.1% to 27.2%, so the sharp price moved into line with the rest of the market rather than ahead of it. The handicap held at Rodez +0.25 with a flat 0.13 fair line across 17.6 hours and five snapshots, and the 1x2 home and away gains are largely the arithmetic of shaving draw probability. Over 3.0 sits at 48.1% with a fair total of 2.93, inside the noise band; both teams to score is 63.0%. Caveat: the true opening price is unknown and history covers only 17.6 hours.

voices.scout: Montpellier are favoured at about forty per cent to Rodez's thirty-three, the draw trimmed to twenty-seven. The sharp market cut the draw from thirty point eight to twenty-seven point three while the handicap stood at Rodez plus a quarter. It reshuffled the three-way book without touching its view on the margin.
voices.sceptic: That reads as the sharp market leading everyone. It isn't. When we first saw it, the draw sat at thirty point eight against a consensus of twenty-eight point one. Now it's twenty-seven point three against twenty-seven point two. It walked back into line. That's a stale first price being corrected, not news arriving.
voices.gaffer: So the final reading. Montpellier favoured at thirty-nine and a half per cent, Rodez thirty-three, the draw twenty-seven. Goals near a coin-flip, both teams to score the majority view at sixty-three per cent, and a goal-margin view that never moved. The one big move was a stale price walking home.
